title: libscanR: Analysis and visualisation of laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy data
description: libscanR provides a research workflow for importing, preprocessing, calibrating and visualising laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy measurements. It supports matching against user-supplied atomic-line references, univariate and multivariate calibration, exploratory chemometrics, heuristic tissue classification and spatial mapping. An explicit two-stage Saha-Boltzmann calculation requires user-supplied physical and instrument-response inputs. Detection-limit estimates and model performance retain their calculation and evaluation basis. Synthetic examples verify software behaviour; they do not establish instrument or clinical validity.
notes: Development draft. No new archival publication is claimed. MIT covers the software only. No atomic reference compilation is bundled; users obtain and configure their own reference under its provider terms.
